capability_claim: Reliably reconstruct coupled finite latent mappings and repair a single corrupted observation under modular arithmetic constraints.
determinism: Python random.Random with explicit seed; canonical JSON serialization
difficulty_mechanisms: unknown bijection between manifest station names and local node names
unknown bijection of five distinct modular clock rates to nodes
unknown per-node modular offsets and counter wraparound
unknown packet-to-manifest bijections within repeated directed routes

item_schema.allowed_rates: array of distinct integers, used bijectively
item_schema.logs: array of public local log records, grouped chronologically by node
item_schema.manifests: array of trusted packet timing records

non_duplicate_rationale: Unlike QA or general agent tasks, each item is an auditable distributed-trace identification problem with interacting graph, modular-clock, matching, and error-correction layers and a deterministic uniqueness certificate.
